corpus: to be or not to be

init.rng: Julia Xoshiro256++ (randn); reproduce the distributions, not the draws

train.greedy_from_to_be_or: to be or not to be

roundoff_sensitivity.note: largest change of the loss trajectory / of theta_final when θ₀ is perturbed by ~1 ulp per entry: the floor for comparing an independent implementation

conventions.arrays: {shape, data}: data in column-major order, entry [i1, i2, …] (1-based) at data[(i1-1) + shape[1]*((i2-1) + shape[2]*(…))] (0-based index into data)
conventions.tokens: 1-based ids into vocab; batch.x[b] is window b (its T input ids), batch.y[b] its T targets, y[t] = x[t+1]
conventions.columns: token column n = (b-1)*T + t holds position t of window b; N = T*B
conventions.theta: θ is one flat vector; layout gives each parameter's offset (0-based) and shape (column-major)
conventions.LN: LN(x; γ, β) = γ ⊙ (x - mean(x)) / sqrt(mean((x - mean(x))^2) + eps) + β, per column
conventions.heads: head h uses rows (h-1)d+1 … hd of Q, K, V, O, with d = D/H
conventions.S: S[i, j, h, b] = q_i · k_j / √d for head h of window b, BEFORE the causal mask (j > i included)
conventions.A: A[:, :, h, b] = softmax over each row of (S[:, :, h, b] + M), M[i, j] = -Inf for j > i, else 0
conventions.O: O_h = V_h A_hᵀ per window, heads stacked back into D rows
conventions.block: Xmid = X + Wo O + bo; ln2 = LN(Xmid; γ2, β2); U = W1 ln2 + b1; R = relu(U); Y = W2 R + b2; Xout = Xmid + Y
conventions.Xf: Xf = LN(X_L; γf, βf), the input of the readout; Z = Wout Xf + bout
conventions.loss: mean over the N columns of logsumexp(Z[:, n]) - Z[y_n, n]
conventions.grad: ∇θ of the loss at theta0, laid out like θ
conventions.train: step t = 1…steps: g = ∇θ loss (full batch); if |g| > clip: g *= clip/|g|; then AdamW with η_t
conventions.schedule: η_t = η t/warmup for t ≤ warmup, else ηmin + (η - ηmin)(1 + cos(π (t - warmup)/(steps - warmup)))/2
conventions.adamw: m = β1 m + (1-β1) g; v = β2 v + (1-β2) g²; θ = θ - η_t ((m/(1-β1^t)) / (sqrt(v/(1-β2^t)) + ε) + λ_i θ), m = v = 0 at the start
conventions.decay: λ_i = weight_decay for entries of matrices (layout shapes with 2 dims), 0 for vectors (γ, β, biases)
conventions.trainloss: train.loss[k+1] is the loss after k updates, k = 0 … steps (loss[1] = forward.loss up to rounding)
